# AgentGuard

> AgentGuard is a deterministic policy firewall, invoice threat scanner, and two-phase PayPal AUTHORIZE escrow console for autonomous AI payment agents.

AgentGuard sits between autonomous AI buyer agents (connecting via Model Context Protocol) and PayPal payment APIs so untrusted agents cannot bypass spending limits, execute prompt-injected invoices, or settle funds without human verification.

## Core Capabilities

- **Deterministic Policy Engine**: Enforces per-transaction maximum limits, rolling 24-hour spending caps, currency validation, and merchant allowlists in code decoupled from LLM reasoning.
- **Invoice Threat Scanner**: Verifies line-item arithmetic, flags typosquatted merchant domains and suspicious payment links, and fails closed on adversarial prompt injections.
- **PayPal Two-Phase AUTHORIZE Escrow**: Creates orders exclusively with `intent: "AUTHORIZE"` so funds are held without automatic capture until approved or voided by an authenticated human operator.

## Console Routes

- [Firewall & Escrow Overview](https://agentguard-frontend-qrs8.onrender.com/): Real-time operational metrics, risk score distribution, and live transaction activity.
- [Transaction Explorer](https://agentguard-frontend-qrs8.onrender.com/transactions): Searchable audit registry of evaluated purchase requests, firewall decisions, and escrow states.
- [Human Approval Center](https://agentguard-frontend-qrs8.onrender.com/approvals): Verification queue where human operators capture or void held authorizations.
- [Policy Management](https://agentguard-frontend-qrs8.onrender.com/policies): Administrative controls for spending caps, velocity budgets, and trusted merchant allowlists.
- [Security Analytics](https://agentguard-frontend-qrs8.onrender.com/security-analytics): Adversarial threat metrics, blocked attack categories, and risk distribution histograms.

## Source & Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/isatyam18/agentguard): Complete source code, FastAPI backend, MCP gateway, and test suites.
